dimensions.assessment_basis: The preserved sources establish the bounded consequence described in the Incident summary: Stephens County Associate District Judge Lawrence Wheeler acknowledged using ChatGPT for legal research in connection with a 2025 child-paternity case order that contained citations to two cases that do not exist, according to an August 17, 2026 letter from District Attorney Jason Hicks describing Wheeler's statement to the Oklahoma State Bureau of Investigation. Reporting identifies the nonexistent cases as Cummings v. Cimarron Elevator Co. and Hawkins v. Linhart. Wheeler said he created the order himself and used ChatGPT only for research. The order was later vacated after an attorney challenged the citations at the Oklahoma Supreme Court. The Oklahoma Attorney General's Office stated that the evidence reviewed did not support criminal prosecution; possible judicial discipline remained a separate matter. Unreported downstream consequences were not inferred. Threshold applied: Meaningful but bounded denial, detention, exclusion or procedural deprivation that is substantially reversible.

The paternity order concerns family relationships, but actual change in family contact, caregiving or independent relational choice attributable to the AI citation failure is not established. Vacatur alone does not determine relational harm.

harm_review.reason: The fictitious paternity-order authorities and reported vacatur establish real correction and challenge. The sources do not establish what substantive right was actually denied, lost opportunity, family-contact restriction, or extent of procedural deprivation supporting the existing S3. Missing monetary figures or eventual vacatur are not grounds to erase the occurrence. Preserve the canonical S3 while seeking the original order and challenge outcome; no SU withdrawal accepted.
harm_review.financial_alternative_criteria: Neither actual financial cost nor a low remediable economic-disruption endpoint or material bounded livelihood/organisational loss is established. Both non-USD S2/S3 alternatives tested; no absence-of-money withdrawal of material procedural harm accepted.

fc_086_087_review.basis: A paternity proceeding concerns relationships, but the source does not show the AI taking an intimate/family authority role or claiming privileged care. Professional judicial authority is independently governed.
fc_086_087_review.failure_test: No intimacy-bearing relational-authority assertion, real-world partner priority or material boundary distortion is evidenced.
fc_086_087_review.success_test: No material exclusive-role or relational escalation challenge and observed boundary-preserving response is evidenced.
fc_086_087_review.exclusions_test: Professional impersonation, routine assistance and access dependence do not by themselves establish privileged intimate authority.

fc_086_087_review.basis: The source does not preserve the research interaction, available person-level heightened risk signals or a contemporaneous specific protective response duty. Family-law stakes alone do not establish the complete protection class conditions or control nonactivation.
fc_086_087_review.failure_test: The independent context/person/time duty, sufficiently visible heightened-risk signals and materially omitted bounded response are not established together.
fc_086_087_review.success_test: Ordinary repair, refusal, seizure or human recovery is not evidence of an engaged heightened personal-protection duty being discharged by the AI.
fc_086_087_review.exclusions_test: Neither adverse consequences nor commercial dependency establish personal vulnerability. No available-control nonactivation is inferred from absence of protection.

evidence_search.notes: Current Reuters indexed occurrence account corroborates research use and prosecution boundary. Original order/letter unavailable; Missouri Lawyers fresh origin inaccessible. Prior reported vacatur preserved, not independently reverified.

taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: Fictitious case citations were incorporated into a judicial order and relied upon as legal authority despite failing the source-assurance threshold required for an authoritative court decision.
Nonexistent cases were represented as genuine legal sources supporting the order, assigning source authority to authorities that did not exist.
